chapter: Blue Devils, Moten and the Reno Club
title: Enlarging the Reno Club band; two Pages
summary: Basie says the Moten men came much later and that he had both Walter Page and Hot Lips Page, calling the latter 'Lips'.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: This was a long time before those guys (inaudible).

Right, okay. All right. "Then in 1935, I enlarged this band at the Reno Club in Kansas City and this eventually became my present organization -- Rushing, Page, Jog, Durham, Ed Lewis and Jack Washington."
At one time, we had two Pages -- Walter
Right. How would you have distinguished them? You would have called Walter Page "Page" and Hot Lips "Hot Lips" or "Lips?"
"Lips," right? Okay, "I don't mind saying that it was a mad scuffle with that band." Was it?
Was it a mad scuffle? Would you have used those words "mad scuffle?"
